messages:
maya (eng-platform): quick Q — where's the canonical place to look at KV/prefix cache hit-rate dashboards? got woken up by an alert at 3am, want to triage noise and understand what panels/queries we should use.

sam (sre): Grafana: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/kv-caches/kvs-overview (panel: "Prefix cache hit rate"). that's the one the alert points at. the alert rule is in prometheus rulegroup 'platform-cache-alerts'.

maya (eng-platform): thanks — can you paste the PromQL? want to see how they compute it (percent vs ratio).

sam (sre): sure — current rule (simplified):
```
( sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])) ) * 100
```
Alert triggers if value < 60 for 10m (severity=page).

jonathan (devex): two quick notes: 1) the visualization in that dashboard uses a rolling 1h avg which makes the panel look smoother than the alert timeseries. 2) there are several routes where we send low-QPS requests (prefetch jobs) that skew the ratio when they fail — curious if the nights alerts line up with a slow external dependency.

maya (eng-platform): that makes sense. the page said <60% — we saw a drop to ~58 for ~12 minutes which probably fired the page. can we tune it to avoid paging for like a 5% transient dip?

sam (sre): recommendation: change paging threshold to <45% for 15m, and create a warning alert at <60% for 10m (ops runbook step). that reduces false pages but keeps visibility. we should validate impact with some historical data (last 30d).

lina (eng-platform): I can run a quick query against the last 30d. quick prometheus query to get pct as a timeseries for heads up:
```
100 * sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (prefix) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (prefix)
```
then compare 95th/5th percentiles over windows.

maya (eng-platform): perfect — can you also add which dashboards show traces/logs for a specific prefix when the hitrate drops?

sam (sre): traces: Tempo has traces with span tag `cache.prefix` (search `cache.prefix=/<prefix>`). logs: Loki stream `app=prefix-cache` with labels `prefix` and `shard`. dashboard links: the panel has a fast link to "Open traces" and "Open logs" in the upper-right — but direct links are:
- logs (Loki): https://logs.internal.redwood.com/loki/goto?query={app="prefix-cache",prefix="<PREFIX>"}
- traces (Tempo): https://tempo.internal.redwood.com/trace?query=cache.prefix%3D%22<PREFIX>%22

jonathan (devex): also add an alert suppression for maintenance windows (we've had noisy prefetch jobs during backups). put `for: 15m` on warning and patch the routing so runbooks go to infra-oncall first.

lina (eng-platform): ran the 30d comparison — most prefixes sit ~>85% median, but a ~10% tail of prefixes dip under 60 during backup windows. attaching quick summary (snip):
- median across prefixes: 88%
- 95th percentile min: 64%
- number of prefix-days under 60%: ~42 in 30d (mostly between 02:00-04:00 UTC)

maya (eng-platform): thanks — sounds like backups cause the noise. plan: sampler: change alerting to warning/page split (sam suggested) and add a Grafana panel that shows classification by prefix (heatmap) so SRE can quickly see which prefix.

sam (sre): i'll open the alert PR to set paging to <45% for 15m and add warning <60% for 10m. tagging infra-oncall.

ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-04-12-kv-cache-noise linked (auto): https://incidents.internal.redwood.com/INC-2026-04-12-kv-cache-noise

lina (eng-platform): i'll create the heatmap panel and a dashboard variable for `prefix` so we can narrow to one. will post PR by EOD.

maya (eng-platform): appreciate it. can someone add a quick line to the alert runbook: "if only a small set of prefixes are affected and it's during backup window, silence for backup-window and monitor; otherwise page"?

sam (sre): yep i'll add that to the runbook in the PR. assign to @infra-oncall for review.

maya (eng-platform): cool — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

lina (eng-platform): followup: PRs — alert change: https://git.internal.redwood.com/platform/ops/infra-alerts/pull/432
heatmap panel: https://git.internal.redwood.com/platform/grafana-dashboards/pull/97

maya (eng-platform): confirmed, closing the thread once PRs merge.
